messages.content:
A person asked this in the Slack thread of an incident Argus is responding to:

what has Argus done about this so far?

This is everything Argus has recorded about the incident, oldest first:

- 2026-10-26T12:08:02Z Argus: Received HighErrorRate on io-shop
- 2026-10-26T12:08:02Z Argus: Moved the incident to INVESTIGATING - a worker took the incident up
- 2026-10-26T12:08:02Z Argus: Called in the Investigator Agent
- 2026-10-26T12:08:03Z Investigator Agent: Asked for the service's per-minute metrics, anchored on 12:08
- 2026-10-26T12:08:03Z Investigator Agent: Read back 361 minutes of metrics
- 2026-10-26T12:08:04Z Investigator Agent: Placed the start of the incident at 12:02
- 2026-10-26T12:08:04Z Investigator Agent: Recorded where the 3 replicas run - all on Tesla-V100-SXM2-16GB
- 2026-10-26T12:08:04Z Investigator Agent: Asked for production change events - deploys, releases and flag changes on the service, the 1 day before Oct 26 12:02
- 2026-10-26T12:08:04Z Investigator Agent: Read back 1 production change
- 2026-10-26T12:08:04Z Investigator Agent: Read how far the deployment had rolled out - all 3 replicas run one revision, which the history does not name
- 2026-10-26T12:08:04Z Investigator Agent: Asked for the service's log lines, the 36 minutes before 12:08
- 2026-10-26T12:08:04Z Investigator Agent: Read back 138 log lines
- 2026-10-26T12:08:04Z Investigator Agent: Read the service register - the service calls io-pricing (internal, owned by checkout-platform), io-summary-cache (internal, owned by checkout-platform), io-pay (third-party, owned by IO Payments Ltd)
- 2026-10-26T12:08:04Z Investigator Agent: Formed 1 candidate cause, best first: The feature flag monthly-spend-feature was switched on at 12:02. The newly enabled spend summary code path then raised ZeroDivisionError at src/io_shop/spend_summary.py:47, and the error rate rose from about 1% to 30-35%. No deployment was recorded, and the 3 replicas had converged.
- 2026-10-26T12:08:04Z Investigator Agent: Read every channel available
- 2026-10-26T12:08:04Z Argus: Read the flag provider's history - 1 flag change by anyone but Argus, the 1 hour before 12:08:04
- 2026-10-26T12:08:04Z Argus: Moved the incident to MITIGATING to act on the leading candidate
- 2026-10-26T12:08:04Z Argus: Called in the Mitigation Agent
- 2026-10-26T12:08:04Z Mitigation Agent: Reverted the feature flag monthly-spend-feature, moved from ON to OFF
- 2026-10-26T12:08:07Z Mitigation Agent: Waiting to see whether the service is still at the incident's level, from 12:09 - up to 120s
- 2026-10-26T12:08:07Z Mitigation Agent: Looked at the service - still at the incident's level
- 2026-10-26T12:10:03Z Mitigation Agent: Looked at the service - no longer at the incident's level since 12:08
- 2026-10-26T12:10:03Z Mitigation Agent: Judged the action CONFIRMED
- 2026-10-26T12:10:03Z Argus: Moved the incident to MITIGATED - set flag [monthly-spend-feature] OFF and the rule that fired stopped firing
- 2026-10-26T12:10:11Z Code-Fix Agent: Proposed a fix as a draft pull request - https://github.com/ohadraz/Argus-Demo-Target-App/pull/360
- 2026-10-26T12:10:12Z Argus: Filed what was tried on this incident: putting monthly-spend-feature back
- 2026-10-26T12:10:13Z Postmortem Agent: Wrote the postmortem - The service broke at 12:02 UTC and was back to normal at 12:08:04 UTC, 6 minutes 4 seconds later. 26.1% of requests failed while it was broken, against 1.2% before it began. At its worst, 36.5% failed. The shop's takings fell short of the same hours on earlier weeks by 4,006.73 USD, beyond how much those hours vary on their own. Turning on a new monthly spending summary set off a calculation that likely crashes for shoppers who had bought before but not this month, so their account pages failed. What Argus did: reverted the feature flag monthly-spend-feature (can be put back) - confirmed, still in place. Argus opened a draft fix, PR #360, for a person to review and merge. The faulty division was still in the code, so turning monthly-spend-feature back on would likely make account pages fail again for shoppers with no purchases this month.

Answer only from these lines. Where they do not hold the answer, say that the record does not say, rather than guessing. Do not say Argus will do anything; answer what happened.

Call submit_answer with your answer.
